source.title: A warp drive with predominantly positive invariant energy density and global Hawking-Ellis Type I
source.author: Jose Rodal
source.relationship: Exact published metric family, standardized parameters; no claim of a global state-of-the-art minimum.

cabin.meaning: A fixed proper spatial ball in flat spatial slices; stationary comoving worldlines are timelike if the shift norm is below one. The metric is approximately flat within it.

family.name: rodal_irrotational_potential_with_axisymmetric_compact_perturbations
family.coordinate_frame: comoving q=(x_lab-2ct,y,z); time coordinate u=ct has units metres
family.g0: g0(r)=r^-1*integral_0^r [1-F(a)]da, g0(0)=0; F is Rodal Eq14
family.regularity: Potential C5 and metric C4 across perturbation joins; published baseline is smooth.
family.asymptotics: Infinite tail is retained. W tends to beta*e_x; laboratory coordinates are asymptotically Minkowski.

objective.observer: n=(1,-W), unit normal to u=constant slices
objective.future_official_score: certified upper bound U in joules
objective.current_score_status: numerical estimate, not a certified score

draft_admissibility_caps.scope: Global derivative bounds are required by the draft specification but not yet proved. Sampled diagnostics do not establish admissibility.
